guard: a persistent permanent SDK replacement refusal terminates the shipped Jcode host before another bridge launch

mutations.name: M1 retry a permanent SDK replacement refusal
mutations.expectRed: persistent invalid_request replacement refusal is terminal before another launch
mutations.cell: a persistent invalid_request replacement refusal is terminal before another launch

mutations.name: M2 drop three advertised direct permanent SDK codes
mutations.expectRed: the direct permanent classifier has exactly seven named SDK codes
mutations.cell: the direct permanent classifier has exactly seven named SDK codes

mutations.name: M3 stop classifying connect_failed EACCES as permanent
mutations.expectRed: connect_failed with EACCES classifies as permanent
mutations.cell: connect_failed with EACCES classifies as permanent

mutations.name: M4 classify unknown HarnessError codes as permanent
mutations.expectRed: an unknown HarnessError code remains transient by default
mutations.cell: an unknown HarnessError code remains transient by default
